one_liner: CivicState turns civic issues into cited official letters, but remains watchlist until paid validation.
thesis: CivicState can become a transactional civic-letter product if users pay for verified research, official targeting, and delivery.
evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md describes CivicState as the product.
apps/api and apps/worker implement the core scaffold.
tests cover payments, treasury, officials, delivery, moderation, compliance, and citations.
assumptions: The dispatch project id mismatch is a registry/operator issue rather than a different product.
The operator wants this evaluated as a business despite watchlist status.
Paid conversion, deliverability, and official coverage can clear validation gates.
decision: Do not approve for roadmap authority yet; keep gate at needs-revision until operator merge and market validation.
